items.description: Complete 1910 sung archival recording with musical accompaniment and surface noise. Full lyrics not bundled; the text panel is a credited summary with a lyrics source link.

items.cultural_context: Robert Burns collected and reworked a Scots song associated with friendship and Hogmanay. Frank C. Stanley’s 1910 performance uses English adaptations and Scots words; it is not a Spanish song. The linked Scots original differs from the performed wording.
items.difficulty_note: C1 editorial listening estimate, not a tested CEFR rating: Scots words, historical adapted wording, sung phrasing and cylinder noise add difficulty. English catalog label reflects the adapted performance.
